brief:
A rights group has accused Israel of systematically working to "eliminate" living conditions for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, according to a new report cited by Middle East Eye. The investigation documents what the organization characterizes as deliberate practices targeting Palestinian infrastructure and access to basic services across the territory.

The report's findings follow a pattern of documented restrictions on Palestinian movement, resource access, and development in areas under Israeli control or administration.
dek: Israel trying to 'eliminate' living conditions for Palestinians in occupied West Bank, says report Israel is systematically trying to "eliminate" living conditions for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, according to a new report by a rights group.
title: Rights group accuses Israel of systematically eliminating Palestinians' living conditions
